steps.step: the operations list shows the project operations
a row opens the operation detail with its own name
steps.detail: operation name shown; operation id shown

steps.step: the same operation under another project is refused with the reason and no detail
steps.detail: refusal with the reason shown; no operation detail shown

steps.step: pausing a running operation with a reason reports the pause and offers Resume
resuming the paused operation rechecks it and reports it resumed
stopping the operation with a reason reports the stop and then that it stopped
steps.detail: stop requested reported; operation stopped reported

steps.step: a viewer sees the pause control locked with its reason and gets no dialog or success report
steps.detail: Pause locked; reason shown; no dialog; no success report
